question: For the calendar year 2021, what is the overall average quantity sold of the top three best-selling hardware products (by total quantity sold) in each division?
sql:
WITH product_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        p.division,
        p.product_code,
        SUM(fs.sold_quantity) as total_quantity_sold
    FROM hardware_fact_sales_monthly fs
    JOIN hardware_dim_product p ON fs.product_code = p.product_code
    WHERE fs.date LIKE '2021-%'
    GROUP BY p.division, p.product_code
),
ranked_products AS (
    SELECT 
        division,
        product_code,
        total_quantity_sold,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY division ORDER BY total_quantity_sold DESC) as rn
    FROM product_totals
)
SELECT 
    AVG(total_quantity_sold) as overall_average_quantity
FROM ranked_products
WHERE rn <= 3
